newsitem.title: USA: PP&L commences preferred stock offering.
newsitem.headline: PP&L commences preferred stock offering.

text.p: PP&L Resources Inc Monday commenced offers to purchase any and all of the outstanding shares of preferred stock of its subsidiary, Pennsylvania Power & Light Company, at the prices indicated below for such shares:

Each of the offers is independent and is not conditioned upon a minimum number of shares being tendered. Each offer is being made only by means of, and is subject to, certain other terms and conditions as set forth in the Offer to Purchase dated March 3, 1997 and the related Letter of Transmittal.

The offer and withdrawal rights for the 4-1/2 percent preferred stock and each series of series preferred stock will expire at 2400 EST/0500 GMT on Friday, April 4, 1997, unless the offer for such series is extended, the company said.

Holders of record on March 10, 1997 of tendered shares will be entitled to the regular quarterly dividend payable on April 1, 1997 irrespective of when they tender their shares. Holders of shares purchased pursuant to the offers will not be entitled to any dividends in respect of any later dividend periods.

The Dealer Manager for the offers is Merrill Lynch & Co. and the Depositary for the tendered shares is Norwest Bank Minnesota, N.A. The company said their announcement is neither an offer to purchase nor a solicitation of an offer to sell shares and that offers are made solely by the Offer to Purchase, dated March 3.
PP&L Resources, Inc., based in Allentown, Pa., is the parent company of Pennsylvania Power & Light Co., Power Markets Development Co. and Spectrum Energy Services Corp.
Pennsylvania Power & Light supplies electricity to a 10,000-square-mile area of 29 counties in Central Eastern Pennsylvania.
